_note: ASSUMPTIONS, not measurements. Every value here is a stated input to results/cost.json. Change them and rerun `uv run bench report`.

power_w.why: Wall power of a 14-inch M4 Pro laptop under sustained GPU inference. Not measured here: powermetrics needs root. Plausible range 40-90 W.

eur_per_kwh.why: German household electricity price order of magnitude, 2026.

hardware_eur.why: Purchase price of a 48 GB M4 Pro laptop, order of magnitude.

amortization_years.why: Typical depreciation period for a laptop.

utilization_scenarios.why: Share of the amortization period the machine spends serving. Energy-only is reported separately as the marginal cost of an already-owned machine.

hosted_price_points_eur_per_m_tokens.why: Illustrative price tiers, not quotes from a vendor. The robust output is the break-even price, which needs no hosted price at all.
